encounters.title: A Dog’s Life by Choice
rewards: Hero Title - Every Dog Has Its Day

unlock.summary: Drink The Wine Guarded by the Three Dogs in Blissful Retreat

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, turn back into a human and travel to the Riverside Station.
Er Lang will explain the situation to you.
Ask You Fubao to join his Lucky Hound Gang, choose the following options in your conversation; 1.
choices: 2. I do whatever the boss says

walkthrough.objective: You Fubao will lead you back to Riverside Station.
Approach the Howling Gang.
As the new leader, you order You Fubao to act more human.
After speaking with Er Lang, investigate the missing dogs by going to the entrance of Harvestfall Village.

unlock.summary: Speak with Granny Shi at Evercare Clinic After Completing Still Shore

walkthrough.objective: On the house above the clinic, speak with Granny Shi.
Go down to the clinic and speak with Yao Yao, select Scent of the Soulmate.
Next, she will ask for three Buggleweeds.
Next, she will ask for some Agarwood.
Speak with the merchant and ask for some Agarwood.
Go back to Granny Shi and hand over the Agarwood.
After arriving at Blissful Retreat, follow the waypoint to Granny's location.
This girl is Granny; she has regained her youth.
Cen Ping and Sanniang will be reunited, but Cen Ping will die soon after.

unlock.summary: Approach Zhang Yihao On the Cliff Near the Mysterious Outpost

walkthrough.objective: Speak with Zhang Yihao, and he will tell you about how the Nine Mortal Ways scams have depleted the sect's resources.
Chengshi will be sitting on a rock at the base of the pagoda tree.
Look for the first victim in Finesteed Hamlet.
Look for the second victim in Harvestfall Village, he will be laying down on the beach beside a cooking pot.
Look for the third victim near Porcelain Kiln.
Return to the pagoda tree to look for Chengshi.
The real Fang Chengshi arrives.

unlock.summary: Join the Crowd Gathered in Front of the Entrance to Harvestfall Village
Unlocked as You Approach the Large Tree in Deerforage Grove

walkthrough.objective: Speak with Shi Yimo, she will be swimming by the bridge in Deerforage Grove.
Go to the Porcelain Kiln and search for Shi Yimo.
Next travel to the Thousand Buddha Village, you will find her sitting inside one of the alcoves.
Shi Yimo is poisoned, use your Wind Sense and treat her illness.
After healing Yimo, speak with her again and you find out that the treasure she was looking for were actually poisoned mushrooms.
Yimo will recount how Fuling was thegirl that she saw that was gathering the red poisoned mushrooms.
In exchange for the poisoned mushroom that you ruined, she will ask for three wild mushrooms.

unlock.summary: Speak with Owner of the Food Stall Ma Shenglu
requirements: Defeat the World Boss - Sleeping Daoist

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, speak with Ma Shenglu.
Find the Sleeping Daoist on the Sage's Knoll near the Palace of Annals.
Wake up the Sleeping Daoist; you can choose any option.
After burning the Bai Zhu, you will fall asleep and enter a dreamscape with the donkeys.
With the Daoist proving his innocence, you agree to reveal the Shenglu as a fraud.
Open your bag and eat the meat bun.

unlock.summary: Steal from Yuan Tiantian and Yuan Xianxian

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, climb up to the roof of the building across the Yuan sisters' food stall.
For the first trial, hide and use the Celestial Seize to steal the Pear-Scented Jar from Yuan Tiantian.
For the second trial, hide and use the Celestial Seize to steal the Meat-Scented Pot from Yuan Xianxian.
For the final trial, she will ask you to steal an oil-paper package from the Storyteller's chest that two monkeys guard.
After clearing all three trials, she will give you half of the tonic that was inside the wrapped package.
To confirm the girl's lies, speak with the Yuan Sisters and get their half of the story.

encounters.title: A Toast to Destiny: Part I

unlock.summary: Offer  the Lone Drinker Some Good Wine

walkthrough.objective: Take the Parting Tears from a nearby shelf and offer it to the Lone Drinker.
Serve the Parting Tears then talk to the Lone Drinker afterwards.
Go to the drinking contest venue along with the Lone Drinker.
After the contest, talk to the Lone Drinker then join him at his table.

unlock.summary: Approach the Worried Grandfather Near Riverside Station.

walkthrough.objective: Talk to the Wang Clan Patriarch on the side of the road between Riverside Station and Harvestfall Village.
Proceed to Harvestfall Village and speak to Du the Broker.
Speak to Wang Lan then head back down the road toward the Lumber Camp.
Head to the nearby Tea Stall to purchase some refreshments then visit Wang Lan again the following day.
Return to the carpenter and speak to Mao.
Go back up the road and speak to the Wang Clan Patriarch.
Talk to the guard who has replaced Wang Lan then enter the station.

unlock.summary: Talk to Big Smart Near Encircling Lake

walkthrough.objective: Talk to Big Smart, who seems to be paralyzed in his balancing position.
Treat Big Smart to cure him of his snake bite.
Head up the cliff to find Big Astute also standing paralyzed due to a snake bite.
Next, Big Astute will direct you to his missing brother Great Wisdom, who is lying flat and paralyzed on a rock just up ahead.
After treating Great Wisdom, he will walk down the mountain.

unlock.summary: Approach Old Jiang in Heaven's Pier, who is surrounded by a crowd.
Complete Gift of Gab: Silver Tongue

walkthrough.objective: Travel to the southern area of Moonveil Mountain.
Use Wind Sense to investigate the area until you find a set of footprints.
Swim across the water and approach the pile of crates.
Head to Riverside Station and look for the Humble Monk mentioned by the two individuals on boats.
After winning the debate, speak with Tang Xinci then look for He Wanchun near the Palace of Annals.
Speak to the pair on the bridge to trigger a Rhetoric Duel with Chu the Twelfth.
After reading the letter on the boat, you will need to climb up Peace Bell Tower and meet Tang Xinci there at Zi hour.
Once you get to the top of the tower, make sure to change the time to Zi hour.

unlock.summary: Speak With Qian Feifei in Heaven's Pier During the Zi Hour

walkthrough.objective: During the Zi hour, speak with Feifei, who is kowtowing in fear and burning midnight offerings.
Wait until daytime and go to the Evercare Clinic to speak with Yaoyao and ask for a calming charm for Feifei.
Travel back to Heaven’s Pier and go to the Brewery.
Investigate Liu’er’s home.
Look for Xiaodai standing on a large rock in the area southwest of the brewery with the cherry blossom trees.
Make your way to the roof of the building across from you and pick up the fox toy.
Next, go to the Kilnfire Ridge and look for A’liang.
Leave the wine cellar and speak with Feifei outside.
Follow the waypoint to an area north of the village entrance, and mighty drop onto the brittle floor where the sound is coming from.
Travel back to Yaoyao and hand over the cats.

unlock.summary: Return to the Top of Peace Bell Tower After Completing Melodies of Peace
Approach the Red Gate near the Bamboo Grove in Blissful Retreat

walkthrough.objective: Approach the Servants in Blissful Retreat and join the crowd to listen to their offer.
Head to the location of the first trial in Moonveil Mountain, just outside Heaven's Pier.
Travel to Crimson Peak for the second trial.
Go to Heaven's Pier for the final trial.
At the Winery, approach the Page Boy and answer "Though far, not far; though empty, not empty".
Go back to the Winery and eavesdrop on the conversation between the servant and the Page Boy.
Speak with Lady Zhao to complete the quest.

unlock.summary: Approach the Training Area in Harvestfall Village

walkthrough.objective: Speak with the kids arguing about their parents, Yan A'niu will brag about his father being close to Tian Ying.
Go to Datie just outside the training area and give him the wooden charm.
You will be teleported with Datie to the Encircling Lake.
He will lead you to a Bandit Camp, defeat all the enemies.
There will be a strange noise nearby.
Speak with Datie, after your conversation, follow the source of a strange noise, and find small footprints.
Follow the footsteps to an enemy camp to find that A'niu has been taken by a group of bandits.

unlock.summary: Wake Up Pip Rat During the Zi Hour In the Rat Den

walkthrough.objective: After waking Pip Rat, help him catch the Redmist Beetles on top of the roof.
Follow Pip Rat to the next location.
He will tell you that he needs an Enchanting Lotus.
Give Pip Rat the Strange Decoction II, and this is still not the correct medicine.
Give Pip Rat the Strange Decoction III, This is the correct medicine his mother made.
Clean the Alchemy Furnace, then speak with Embroidered Rat to end the quest.

encounters.title: Moths to a Shimmer
rewards: Hero Title - Moths to a Shimmer

unlock.summary: Approach Shan'er and Nan Weiqing in the Village North of Buddha Fort

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, look for Shan'er and Nan Weiqing near the intersection.
Examine the note by opening your bag, then come close to the pair and read it aloud.
Stand by the entrance and listen in on Shan'er and her mother's argument.
choices: 1. Like amoth to the flame, my days burn away!
2. Like moths to the flame, never ceasing!

walkthrough.objective: Return to Aunt Shan's home and ask her about it.
choices: 1. Point to the painting of beauty

walkthrough.objective: Lure out the Wriggler by Reciting Poetry in the crowd and posting the painting on the Martial Board.
After meeting the Wriggler you piece together the Cocoon Master's true identity.
Speak with Shan'er and stop her.
The next day go back to Aunt Shan's home, she will already have some visitors over.

unlock.summary: Get the Letter From the Lie Brother's

walkthrough.objective: After receiving the letter from the Lie brothers, travel to Encircling Lake.
The farmer is trying to get Cui Xiaojin’s remains home to Harvestfall Village.
Go to Harvestfall Village and look for the Brothers.
Go to the Village Chief and ask him for Lie Bujin’s location, and go to the Northern Vow Ruins to find him.
You can find Lie Bujin on top of the entrance gates in the Northern Vow Ruins.
Speak with the farmer, Lie Bujin will confirm that the person in the coffin really is Cui Xiaojin.
Speak with Bujin; he will tell you to be careful of the framer since he suspects him of being a Khitan.
The Farmer will die as you relay the news to him.
Travel to Crimson Cliff and look for the farmer’s wife, Cai Zhu, under the maple trees.

unlock.summary: Eavesdrop on Yaoyao and Zhen Ai on the Scaffolding in the Thousand-Buddha Village

walkthrough.objective: After eavesdropping on Yaoyao and Zhen Ai’s conversation, confront Yaoyao about her resurrection con.
Travel to Mercyheart Town and gather the Datura King at the specified waypoint.
After delivering the flowers, Yaoyao will ask to meet you the next day at the Zi hour.
Once you reach the right time, speak with Yaoyao.
Shoot a fire arrow at Mr.
Shoot a fire arrow at Mr.
Ai will still be crying where you left her, interact with her, and she will start attacking you.
After defeating her, she will confess that she knows that Yaoyao is a fake, but wanted a Paper Puppet of Mr.

unlock.summary: Dip into the Water at the You Hour in North Buddha Fort

walkthrough.objective: Talk to Er Mengzi and hear him out on his woes about the death of his goose.
Er Mengzi will direct you to Elder Yang's location.
Continue on your way to Elder Yang's house.
After explaining everything to him, Elder Yang will invite you to come back on the next day.
Set the time to the Shen hour on the next day.
Find out where Elder Yang landed.
Listen to Elder Yang's monologue on his failures.

unlock.summary: Get Lion's Roar and Conquer the Outpost in Buddha Fort

walkthrough.objective: Eavesdrop on the conversation between Tongchang and Tongbian.
After defeating the duo, climb up the tower and rescue the Humble Monk.
After a short cutscene, Zhao Maokang will arrive.
If unlocked, you can use the Northern Bamboo Grove Boundary Stone to teleport closer to the quest area.

unlock.summary: Talk to Embroidered Rat in Mercyheart Town

walkthrough.objective: After talking to Embroidered Rat, talk to the other inhabitants of the Rat Den: Rafter Rat, Burrowing Rat, and Barn Rat.
Return to the Rat Den to assess Pip Rat's disappearance.
You will learn that Pip Rat must have fled with the medicine he brewed from the furnace.
By the door to the building, eavesdrop on the two people seated inside.
Follow the villager to Pip Rat's possible location.
With all enemies defeated, free Pip Rat from the cage.
In the Rat Den, talk to Rafter Rat and the others to end the quest.

unlock.summary: Walk Past Old Man Tao in Finesteed Hamlet

walkthrough.objective: Talk to Old Man Tao, who will tell you that he has been tormented by the noise of a “Da Chong”.
Follow the quest marker to the Da Chong, which turns out to be a cricket.
Old Man Tao will tell you that he has also been tormented by ghostly voices in his sleep.
Old Man Tao will believe the hens' crowing to be a bad omen.
Return to the courtyard of Old Man Tao's house, then set the time to two days later.
Li Sanlang will give you the son's letter.
Set the time to the next day then talk to Old Man Tao, who will inform you that he will be moving to Kaifeng to be with his son.

unlock.summary: Acquire the Moonlit Flower Seed and Go to Flower Expanse at the Zi Hour to Plant It

walkthrough.objective: Follow the quest marker towards the circle of flowers at the edge of the flower field.
After a flash of light, a glowing hut will spawn west of the circle of flowers.
The bell teleports you to Harvestfall Village.
Back at the glowing hut in Flower Expanse, a second glowing bell will appear east of the glowing hut.
Once in Flower Expanse again, a third glowing bell will appear west of the glowing hut.
You will be teleported south of Witherwilds, where a deer will lead you towards a dialogue between two spirits.
After the dialogue, keep following the deer until you find a glowing gate.
The quest ends with another flash of light, teleporting you back to Flower Expanse for the final time, lying down in the field of flowers.

unlock.summary: Speak With the Two Men Outside Finesteed Hamlet

walkthrough.objective: After triggering the quest, speak with Hunter Zhou.
Find his home beside Li Daniang's food stall in Finesteed Hamlet.
Pursuade Madam Zhang to let her husband go hunting.
To expose the fortune teller's con, win the Giift of Gab battle against him.
Go back to speak with Madam Zhang, she will tell you that scarred Zhang has already left the village to go hunting.
Still worried, speak with Scarred Zhang the following day.

unlock.summary: Go to the Path of Karma in Sundara Land on a Foggy Day

walkthrough.objective: Once the quest triggers, climb up the stairs on the Path of Karma and speak with the Scholar in white standing in the middle of the road.
Further down the path, speak with Baili Zhui and Baili Zong.
After changing the time, go back down the Path of Karma and walk back upstairs into the fog.
Fast travel to Wraight Village, on the road just ahead of the Boundary Stone, will be a girl.
Inside the ruined building speak with Lady Ning and give her Nie's keepsake.
Go back to the Path of Karma and look for Nie.
After defeating the men, travel to Riverview Terrace to find Nie.

encounters.title: A Toast to Destiny: Part II

unlock.summary: Play a Game of Pitch Pot
requirements: A Toast to Destiny: Part I

walkthrough.objective: Enter the Lone Drinker's house and wait for him to come home.
Go back inside the house and read Qiu Pengsheng's letter.
Go to the Lone Drinker's grave and bury the Jade Flute.

unlock.summary: Listen to Children in Flower Expanse

walkthrough.objective: After triggering the encounter, approach the children outside of Lady Ugly's house and talk to them.
Take a walk with Lady Ugly in the Flower Expanse.
Return to Lady Ugly's house and look for the letter from Water Lady.
Exit the house and speak to the children to have them help you capture three Mutant Golden Mantises.
Return to Lady Ugly's house and tell her about the riddle.
Wind Sense will reveal a set of footprints that lead away from Lady Ugly's house.
Investigate the Open Medical Manual on the ground behind Unfated Tian.
You will wake up in Evercare Clinic after your encounter with Lady Ugly in the waterfall.
After speaking to the children's families, return to Lady Ugly's house to visit her grave.
Interact with the grave one more time and decide what to do with the Disguise Balm and the children.

unlock.summary: Approach the Horse Merchant in Finesteed Hamlet
Approach the Well in General Shrine Late at Night on a Clear Day

walkthrough.objective: On a cloudless night you will hear a voice coming from the well in General Shrine.
Li Wa will ask you to bring him some Braised Pork Belly Slices.
Li Wa will tell you that he also wants freedom.
Move the time forward to the day after tomorrow at the Zi hour.
Check around the well for anything unusual.
Go back to your room in Blissful Retreat and grab the Vintage Wine from the shelf beside the window.
Once the boy wakes up speak with him again before going to the well in Blissful Retreat.

unlock.summary: Triggers When You Defeat Enemy Camps in Vedant Wilds

walkthrough.objective: Approach the Xiao Ping'an.
Converse and tell Xiao Ping'an that you want to learn the martial art.
Show him your Noname Sword: Daunting Strike.
Ask him again how to learn their technique.

unlock.summary: Triggers When You Defeat Enemy Camps in Verdant Wilds

walkthrough.objective: After defeating the enemy camp, speak with the villager waiting nearby.

unlock.summary: Eat All the Meals from the Food Stalls in Qinghe
requirements: Eat All Local Meals in Qinghe

unlock.summary: Challenge Contestants at the Arena

walkthrough.objective: Speak to Wu Bai after challenging some of the contestants at General's Shrine.
Spar with Yuan Jin'gang, Gongsun Deng, Du Qiaoxian, and Elder Gongsun.
Speak to Wu Bai again after your duels.

unlock.summary: Triggers When You Defeat Enemy Camps in Verdant Wilds
Explore Deerforage Grove in Moonveil Mountain

walkthrough.objective: Talk to Iron Hammer Wang and have him tell you about his hammers.
Purchase a hammer from Iron Hammer Wang to have him continue his story.
Keep buying hammers from Iron Hammer Wang until you draw your weapon and his name turns red.
Travel to Stonewash Strand in Verdant Wilds to feed Iron Hammer Wang's Cat.
After feeding the cat, read the nearby note then return to Iron Hammer Wang's location in Deerforage Grove.
When you return to Iron Hammer Wang's location, he will be gone and another one of his victim's will be there instead.

encounters.title: Twisted Destiny
rewards: Hero Title - Guest from the Past

unlock.summary: Visit the Bamboo Retreat and defeat the Wolves
Triggers When You Defeat Enemy Camps in Verdant Wilds.
Find the Map in Heaven's Pier After Completing Chapter 1

walkthrough.objective: Go to Heaven's Pier brewery and search the shelves with the wine jars.
Open the Treasure Map and study the clue.
Speak with the Old Angler; he will tell you the next clue if you win a fishing competition against him.
After winning the competition, he will give you a letter and another Treasure Map.
Use Wind Sense to find where the next clue is.
Travel to Kilnfire Ridge, near the Emperor Chai Temple.
Jump onto the rooftop of the Emperor Chai Temple and look for the next clue; it's right beside the hole in the roof.
Speak with the Hunter and compete with him in a bird shooting contest to get the next clue.
You can fast travel using the Bamboo Retreat Boundary Stone.
Continue searching around the hut, and you will find Ruby's Letter behind the building, near the steps.

unlock.summary: Triggers While Traversing Mistveil Forest

walkthrough.objective: After being poisoned, you will wake up in the Wishing Cove, treated by Zhai Xu.
Attempt to secretly read Zhai Xu's notes.

unlock.summary: Set the Time to You Hour in Masterwood Hamlet

walkthrough.objective: Speak to Xiaojie to learn about the dogs gathered in front of the house.
Find and talk to Old Yang, sitting by a pile of planks, about his dog Buster.
Head to the dog shrine located behind a wall.
Follow the Spirit Beast Master to Old Yang's house.
You can find Jet near the house.
Haihai is at the center of the hamlet, standing by construction of a large building.
The last dog Silk is aggressive, so you cannot take its fur up close.
Once the Master heals Buster, follow everyone outside to a bridge where the other dogs are gathered.

unlock.summary: Complete the Wandering Tale The Eagle's Shadow
Approach the Nine Mortal Ways Member Holding a Harmonic Core

walkthrough.objective: Use Wind Sense on the Mohest Hill Coin Workshop Elder and press the Select Item button to examine the Harmonic Core in his inventory.
Talk to the Elder to ask for the Harmonic Core.
Interact with the basket next to the Elder to draw your luck.
Press the View Items button to check the Harmonic Core Coupon from your inventory.
Talk to Passerby C and complete the Gift of Gab minigame to convince him to quit.
Head north from the Elder's location and push open the two large doors.
Go back to the Elder to complete the Encounter.

unlock.summary: Eavesdrop on Dahu and Erniu

walkthrough.objective: Eavesdrop on Dahu and Erniu.
Fast travel to Kaifeng Prefecture and talk to Leng Qing.
Head to South Gate Avenue and talk to Tian Quan.
Recruit Grandpa Zhang, Scholar Sun, and Shopkeeper Wang.
After recruiting all three, head to Tian Quan's location and listen to the anti-fraud lecture.
Eavesdrop on the Nine Mortal Ways disciples to observe their reaction.
Fast travel to East Cross Street in Kaifeng City and eavesdrop on Jia Xiaoqi.
Fast travel back to Kaifeng Prefecture.
Eavesdrop on the two Nine Mortal Ways disciples to complete the Encounter.

encounters.title: Ballads and Pawprints
rewards: Hero Title - Bard of the Forsaken Quarter

unlock.summary: Tip Old Jun Three Times for Three Days

walkthrough.objective: After successfully triggering the Encounter, talk to Old Jun, who will sing a song for you with his dog Ha Ha.
Set the time to the next day to find Old Jun alone with Ha Ha missing.
At the hideout, eavesdrop on two thugs cooking a meal.
Head into another alley in the quarter, where you will see two beggar children.
After Old Jun decides to accompany you to find Ha Ha, you will arrive at Granny Ren's house.
At the Unbound Cavern's hideout, return to where you fought the thugs cooking their meal.
After Granny Ren treats Ha Ha, return to Ash Pit on the next day at Wei hour.

unlock.summary: Finish Reunion Main Story and Complete Veiled Blades

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, head to the marked location on your map.
Once you reach the marker, you'll need to search for the swordsmen's fabled barbecue meet-up.
Big Zhao will ask you to shop for ingredients, starting with lamb.
Now head to the next destination and speak with the Fishmonger.
Now head back to Big Zhao and watch the cutscene unfold, which will conclude the quest.

unlock.summary: Complete Furnace of Righteousness

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking Help Wanted, head to Zhang Silang's Printing Shop and talk to Zhang Wenqing.
You’ll be tasked with visiting the laborers’ gathering spot.
Return to the Printing Workshop and speak with a less-than-impressed Zhang Wenqing.
Afterwards, go to the marker on the roof and eavesdrop on the conversation below.
Next, head to the front of the Printing Shop and talk to the two applicants, Song Erlang and Ren Sanlang.
Next, head to the marker and speak with Old Man Ding to ask about Shen Pingbo.
Head to the marker and talk to Shen Pingbo!
Now, you’ll need to advance the time to the next day until Wu Hour.
Speak with Zhang Wenqing once more, then advance the time by two days before talking to him again to complete the quest.

unlock.summary: Finish Furnace of Righteousness

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the Chivalrous Escort quest, follow the quest marker to speak with Qian Rongmao and purchase the ticket for 4,000 Coins to c…
Find a seat in the theater and watch the cutscene.
This cutscene is long, so sit back and enjoy!

unlock.summary: Talk to Big Zhao at the Imperial Artisan Court at the Shen Hour

walkthrough.objective: Slide on the ground
Hold, lift up
Yesterday morning
Bully
Get scolded
Lie
Squat, crouch
Show off, flaunt
Powerful, a force to be reckoned with
*A Kaifeng curse word

unlock.summary: Speak with the Wailing Child in Fairgrounds

walkthrough.objective: After talking to Ge Mang, he will invite you to follow him to a Nine Mortal Ways camp.
Make a portrait of the slacker Wu Ban in the stall.
Go to the second slack-off place, by a wrestling ring, to find Ma Lou.
Talk to Ma Lou on the roof of the teahouse, just above He Xiaocheng.
Go to the third slack-off place and talk to the men gathered by a table.
The officer, Jia Gongze, is behaving unusually, so use Celestial Seize to grab the book he is reading.
Return to Mo Yuwang and eavesdrop on his conversation with Xie Dai.

unlock.summary: Open the Notice from Kaifeng Prefecture Letter

walkthrough.objective: Go to the alley near the Main South Gate in Kaifeng City and eavesdrop on the Clumsy Constable then talk to him afterwards.
Read the notice on the wall in front of the Clumsy Constable then talk to the Clumsy Constable again.
Remove the three (3) fake notices around the area.
After removing all fake notices, go to the marked location on the bridge near the Harmonic Span boundary stone.
Go in front of the Kaifeng Prefecture Office near the Kaifeng Prefecture boundary stone and eavesdrop on Zhen Laoba.

unlock.summary: Approach the Man Standing Near the Back Entrance of Brokegate Village

walkthrough.objective: Speak with the man lying on the side of the road.
You will be teleported to the Riverlake Village.
Follow the gold mark and investigate the situation in the village.
Sneak into the village and listen in on the different conversations from the rooftops.
Follow the girl that you see sneaking around at night, and you will be interrupted by the watchmen.
Return to the man and find a suitable spot to listen in on their conversation.
Hide behind the wooden fence and eavesdrop on the man.
Talk with Everyone to end the quest.

unlock.summary: Go to the Abandoned Shrine in Marsh Plain at the Xu Hour

walkthrough.objective: Talk to the laborers in front of the cart carrying a stele.
After taking shelter in an abandoned house, you will hear a noise where the stele is parked and the inscription on it will mysteriously disa…
Follow the quest marker in the direction of Lion Barrow, where the stonemason Master Shi is located.
Go behind the stele to find Master Shi passed out on the ground.
Once Master Shi has been treated, follow him to a stele.
Repair three more steles by walking up to them and selecting the prompt to restore them.
Return to the laborers at the Abandoned Shrine and fix the inscription on the stele.
Defeat the stranger.
After explaining the situation to the stranger and laying Master Shi to rest, the stranger will disappear and leave another small knife on t…

unlock.summary: Approach the House in the Center of Brokegate Village

walkthrough.objective: After speaking with Madam Liu, look for Hao Youxian near the entrance of the village, close to the Boundary Stone.
Speak with Hao Youxian, after that, walk away and use Celestial Seize to take Ying Ziying’s Note and the Clay Tiger Tally.
Deliver these items to Madam Liu, and she will ask you to investigate others who received the same note.
Find Ji Youde fishing near the entrance of the village.
Find Wang Fugui; he will be kowtowing in front of a brazier near a house west of the village.
Investigate the area north of the village, follow the waypoint to get to the location.
Read the note, then move the time forward to the Zi hour.
Speak with the fallen man after he is revealed.
After revealing the scam, Hao Youxian will fight you.
After the fight, treat Madam Liu.

unlock.summary: Complete the Injustice Quest - Melodic Trial: A Tale of Two Dragons
requirements: Injustice Quest - Melodic Trial: A Tale of Two Dragons

walkthrough.objective: Talk to the Fishing Elder and the Divination Elder, who will claim to be the Dragon Kings of the Jing and Wei Rivers.
Follow the quest marker to the bodies of Madam Zhang and her daughter on the road.
After automatically escorting the pair to Mustard Hut and obtaining the Soulbreaker vial, return to the Dragon Kings in Huayin North.
Head east to Riverlake Village and follow the quest marker to a pier to dig up a chest and two bodies.
Change the time to the next day and meet with the Li brothers.
Return to the Dragon Kings at the river.
A cutscene will play showing Yuan Buyu and Jiang Wuya in their youth, revealing how they came to be known as the Dragon Kings.
After learning the truth, return to Ren Xia to share your interactions with the Dragon Kings.

unlock.summary: Approach the Group of Men by the River in Pine Bend

walkthrough.objective: After eavesdropping on the group of men, move the time forward by a full day and return to the location.
Speak with Tang Wang, the monk who interfered with the argument the day before.
Study the clues he gave you and speak with him again.
For the first question, answer An Dagui as the one who stole the treasure.
For the second question, he was wearing Green Clothes.
Follow the waypoint to a mound with a buried wooden chest.
A woman, Qiuniang, will arrive.
Confront Tang Wang to end the quest.

unlock.summary: Approach Guo Huailie at Mount Wuwei

walkthrough.objective: Acquire the Gourd of Remembrance under a collapsed roof at the Governor's Residence.
Head to Mount Wuwei and talk to the Elder Guo Huailie then give him the Gourd of Remembrance.
Perform Spirit Writing on the Gourd.
You must then buy grain, oil, and wine from the Merchant at Skybrim Market as an offering to Zhang Huaishen.
To find the grain, you must visit the Agricultural Commissioner at the Reclining Buddha Temple and acquire it from him.
Then, head back to Skybrim Market and find the Oil-Selling Selling Veteran, who will give you the oil that you need.
Finally, visit Kingvine Village and find the Wine King Vine's son, Li Fanglao.
Return to Guo Huailie and perform Spirit Writing once again with the new offerings.

unlock.summary: Speak with Qing Qingqing at Skybrim Market

walkthrough.objective: Go to Skybrim Market, then head up the hill to the north and speak with Qing Qingqing.
After the conversation, Madam Weng, a jar, will speak to you and ask you to find Zhuge Ha using a very vague description.
After speaking with Zhuge Ha, you will be told to head back up the hill toward the troupe's camp.
On the way back, you will find Zhuge Ha again on the road just before reaching the camp.
During the conversation, Zhuge Ha will disguise both himself and you as part of his plan.
Speak with Qing Qingqing again while disguised and exhaust his dialogue to move the encounter forward.
Qing Qingqing will eventually run off.
After the scene, you will return to the camp, where the troupe will perform one last show for you.
Once the performance ends, the troupe will disappear and leave behind a trinket on the ground.

unlock.summary: Collect the Death Pacts from Three Corpses Near Sparrow Sutra Hall

walkthrough.objective: Travel to the Sparrow Sutra Hall Boundary Stone.
Once the encounter begins, use Wind Sense to trace the source of a nearby sound.
Speak with the child first.
Leave the pair for a moment and head up the nearby mountain to find the Elder of the Raging Tides.
Go back down the mountain and speak with the injured man again while the child rests nearby.
Pass time until the next day so the child wakes up, then speak with him.
Escort the child to his parents by horseback.
Return to the Elder of the Raging Tides on the mountain and speak with him once more.

unlock.summary: Speak with The Buddha Hand near Sanctum of Austerity

walkthrough.objective: Teleport to Crystal Shore and move forward a short distance.
Talk to the Soldier standing beside the horse, then speak with the Platoon Leader.
Follow the Platoon Leader until he stops, then speak with him again.
After the conversation, interact with the horse to inspect it.
Once the inspection is done, you will be asked to feed the horse Camelbell Grass.
After feeding the horse, talk to the Hardened Soldier.
When the Officer appears, speak with him, then inspect the Hardened Soldier's corpse nearby.
Once the inspection is finished, talk to the Staff Officer one more time.
Use the in-game time skip feature and set the time to noon on the following day.
Return to the Platoon Leader and speak with him.

unlock.summary: Approach Kang Wobai at the Jade Mirrored Spring

walkthrough.objective: Begin the quest by talking to Kong Wobai.
Afterward, you'll find that Kong Wobai and Wu Zimei are arguing about the better type of poem.
You can help out either Kong Wobai or Wu Zimei in writing their poems by providing them inspiration.
After helping out either of the two poets, you must then decide a winner.
Afterward, you must head to the city tower to find new poetry inspiration.
Return to the two poets at Jade Mirrored Spring.

unlock.summary: Approach the Veteran Near the Intersection Going to Sparrow Sutra Hall

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest, speak with the Veteran and help him pull out the sword.
Catch the sword thief using Wind Sense and defeat him in battle.
Talk to sword thief, Zheng Wusi.
Zheng Wusi will dislocate his shoulder during the conversation.
After the conversation, skip to the next day and find Zheng Wusi's letter on a nearby stone then read it.
Return to the Veteran downhill and talk to him twice.
Once you arrive at the hall, talk to Zheng Wusi.
Search for Clues in the Hall.
Talk to Zheng Wusi inside the hall twice.
Submit Zhang Yichao's Journal to the Veteran to complete the quest.

unlock.summary: Approach with Old Storyteller and Scholar in Skybrim Market

walkthrough.objective: After unlocking the quest speak with the Old Storyteller and Scholar.
Speak with the Woman near the clothing stall.
Go to the Purity Pagoda to Investigate the three miracles.
Enter the temple and eavesdrop on the Bodchen monks.
Connect the Clues.
Go outside and submit the robe to Wuzhen.
Go back to the temple and investigate the big bell outside.
After speaking with the Woman, go back to Wuzhen and talk to him.
The scholar will ask you to give the robe to someonen who deserves it.

unlock.summary: Talk to the Eastbound Monk Near the Camel Station Boundary Stone
Raise Cat Affection with All 13 Cats in Jade Gate Pass
requirements: Pet all cats in Jade Gate Pass

unlock.summary: Pet Pawsie Five Times After Completing The Final Retreat
Approach Granny Yang in Poplar Bazaar

walkthrough.objective: Follow the quest marker to locate the Poplar Leaf Ledger.
The Poplar Leaf Ledger is in a nearby small building with a hole on top.
Return to the camp and talk to Kang Mingluo to share what you found with the ledger.

unlock.summary: Find Three Unparalleled Items in Lost Crossing
Approach the Fire in Peaceward Camp
